snippet.title: Mini Wizards (April 26, 2013)
snippet.description:
Official description: Miniaturize your Xbox Live Avatar and battle against other Mini Wizards in this spell casting action game. Includes LIVE multiplayer and single player survival mode with global scoreboard.

Developer:
Raoghard
Genre:
Action & Adventure
Release Date:
April 26, 2013

Features:
Custom SoundTracks
HDTV 720p
Players: 1
Online Players: 2 - 4
Includes Avatars
